_comment: A source code submission that keeps a vendored library and a build script inside the folder --sca-exp-source names. That folder is split out of the archive's files so the WebExtension checks (API, permission, eval) do not read privileged code - but the vendor pass and the build trace are questions about EVERY file the submission holds, so they read it too (withExperiment). What pins that: the VENDORS.md entry for experiment/lib/thing.js resolves, so there is no missing-vendor-file, and the declared library gets the same audit as any other - its GitHub source cannot be OSV-audited, so vendor-vuln-unknown reports it; and the build review names the network fetch in experiment/build.sh, which the trace could not see while it read only the source view. The xpi/ carries no Experiment declaration: the split is the flag's doing alone, and bg.js loads the library so nothing in the XPI reads as unused.
